title: Retry-count bump inside `catch` can throw and abort the whole cron run
description: Row can be deleted during batch processing, causing the retry-count update at line 190 to throw P2025. Since this throw occurs inside a catch block, it escapes the loop and skips all remaining reminders, causing the endpoint to 500.

title: SMS-lock is counted as a retryable failure, permanently deleting pending reminders
description: SMS-lock state from twilio.scheduleSMS is treated as a retryable failure and incremented at line 178. Reminders with retryCount > 1 are hard-deleted, so teams locked for ~45 minutes permanently lose all pending reminders in the 7-day window with no logging.
